title: Q-CFP-token-scope: the daily cost guard and posture reading cannot read the Ultrastable Cloudflare account
body:
**Owner:** staff
**Trigger:** cost-guard run 44805356832 (2026-11-20): `not authorized for that account` on the GraphQL cost queries and HTTP 403 on every cfposture read
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation cfposture --rule worker-logs-on
**Status:** closed

The repository secret CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN predates the account move and has no access to account 81e3a4efb4eb66e613529b87682911bb, so `deploy/cost-probe.mjs` fails and every CF-POSTURE-1 rule reads unmeasured. Deploys are unaffected: they go through the deploy gateway on GitHub OIDC.

Remedy, no new credential: give `workers/core/deploygate` a read-only `GET /posture` route behind the same OIDC check that returns, with the gateway's own CF_DEPLOY_TOKEN, the script list and each script's observability setting, and have `foundation/cfposture.py` and `deploy/cost-probe.mjs` read through it when CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN is refused. Cost samples already reach the tick Worker through CF_ANALYTICS_TOKEN; point the cost guard at `/api/budget` for D1 rows and neurons. Alert policies, API tokens and members stay unmeasured until a token with those read scopes exists; that is an identity-bound gate and is recorded by the rules as unmeasured, never as passed.

**Disposition:** shelved (executor-failed, 2026-11-21T14:51:54Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 2 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: ValueError: need 1..8 files, got 15. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
